The '''monument to lost navigators''' was a statue in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]]. Commemorating those that had lost their lives exploring new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]], the statue stood in front of the [[Hyperspace Navigator's Guild]]'s [[Hyperspace Navigator's Guildhouse/Legends|headquarters]]. Made of [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], the statue was carved in the likeness of the ancient patriarch of a [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] family that was said to have blazed the [[Koros Trunk Line/Legends|Koros Trunk Line]] aboard a [[Generation ship/Legends|generation ship]].<ref name="NoP" />
